data.description: All Hail the Helldivers, whose devotion to Managed Democracy has never faltered.

data.description: This cape has a visual pattern that when scanned by Automaton sensors translates to “defile your microwave mother, bot scum.”

data.description: Woven for the trailblazers who successfully led the way during the first sanctioned deployment of a new tactical paradigm. data.name: Bugslayer

data.description: This cape reminds us that even faced with the abyssal darkness of space, nothing can stand against our human ingenuity, our powers of collaboration, or our sheer overwhelming numbers.
data.name: Ingress-81

data.description: When children have trouble sleeping, tucking them in under this cape reminds them that they are never alone, for Liberty's unseen defenders are always watching over them.
data.name: Cover of Darkness

data.description: When wearers stand shoulder to shoulder, this cape shows them as they truly are: an unbreakable defense, keeping Freedom safe behind an impregnable wall.
data.name: Stone-Wrought Perseverance

data.description: Artists and sculptors have made countless attempts at depicting the face of Liberty, but the truth is that any citizen can see it—they need only requisition a mirror.
data.name: Vision of Freedom

data.description: Legend tells of the unnamed Helldiver, wandering the edges of Super Earth's reach, delivering Democracy and leveling lawlessness wherever the tumbleweeds lead. Wear this, and keep the legend alive.
data.name: Veil of the Valorous Vagabond

data.description: Made famous by the SEAF commander of the same name, this seal reminds us that only perfect Unity can ensure perfect Freedom.
data.name: Seal of General Consensus

data.description: This cape depicts the inner workings of a medical device submitted to the Ministry of Science 70 years ago, and is bound to clear their patent approval process any day now.
data.name: Schema Laid Bare

data.description: This sigil reaffirms the Helldiver's pledge to protect Managed Democracy, serve Managed Democracy, and uphold Managed Democracy.
data.name: Badge of Order

data.description: Featuring an ancient sun symbol and a distressed look, this cape reminds us that the light of Liberty is everlasting, and will keep shining even when we ourselves have become tattered and frayed.
data.name: Eternal Corona

data.description: Composed of reclaimed industrial mesh and salvaged banners. This cape celebrates the beauty found in the aftermath of purging Tyranny at high-speeds. The debris of these successes, and those like it, remind us all of the sanctity of Sovereignty.
data.name: Scraps of Sovereignty

data.description: This convenient cape can double as ground insulation, warming blanket, or camp roofing to the enterprising defoliator.

data.name: Gilded Quill

data.description: The striking dorsal tread pattern represents the unstoppable, grinding, and uniform march of Managed Democracy. It boldly assures all onlookers that resistance is not merely futile, but also logistically inefficient and statistically disastrous.
data.name: Tread of Liberty

data.description: Salvaged from a deep-storage vault, this well-ventilated cape symbolizes tenacious survival. Its visible scars bestow immediate veteran status, reminding all onlookers that the spirit of tireless service is immortal.
data.name: Testament to Attrition

data.description: By reminding Chemical Agents of proper distancing rules, this extraordinary innovation in cape design ensures that they never cause another unfortunate outbreak of Carcino-Plague.
data.name: Standard of Safe Distance

data.description: Inside the collar is embroidered: "Wherever I may plant my shield, know that I will never yield," and "machine washable."

data.description: Each purchase of this cape comes with a complimentary will and testament amendment form, which guarantees the soon-to-be-deceased a prominent spot on the Wall of Martyrs.

data.description: This cape honors the Eagle pilots who would follow a Stratagem beacon into the very jaws of tyranny, even when the beacon's placement seems inscrutable to the non-Helldiver mind.
data.name: Per Democrasum

data.description: The dauntless pioneers of the Great Expansion, facing the un-Democratic unknown, adopted the Way of the Bandolier. data.name: Way of the Bandolier

data.name: THE BREACH

data.description: A symbol of the constant, forward-moving propulsive force of Managed Democracy. This cape honors those who understand that in the race for Freedom, there are no brakes—only degrees of momentum.
data.name: Vector of Victory

data.description: Featuring a vibrant, high-visibility pattern to signify the inevitable victory of the Federation. This cape reminds all observers that while the road to Liberty is paved with sacrifice, the "podium" at the end is reserved exclusively for the compliant.
data.name: PODIUM OF PROSPERITY

data.description: The symbol on this cape represents the pillars of freedom: duty, obedience, and loyalty.
data.name: Strength in Our Arms

data.description: Commemorating the New Stockholm treaty on prisoners of war, this cape celebrates the right of all enemy combatants to a swift and merciful execution.
data.name: Defender of Our Dream

data.description: Marks the most Free of the Free, those who will seize tyranny by the neck and squeeze until no oppression remains.
data.name: Mark of the Constrictor

data.description: This ancient, likely allegorical, illustration of Might triumphing over the Anguiform is seen by scholars as a symbol of humankind's supremacy in the art of violence.
data.name: Foe Rent Asunder

data.description: A tribute to the mischief-makers and mavericks, those trailblazers who dutifully execute their orders with universally-endearing panache. The star-crossed trail calls to mind the special kind of Freedom that can only be achieved by going very fast in very expensive state-owned vehicles.
data.name: Free-Spirited Spangles

data.description: This cape's retro print, first made popular in GW1 cereal merchandising, helps children remember that not all machines are twisted mechano-socialists; some are piloted by true-hearted humans, and we can all rest easy in their gaze.
data.name: Watchful Compatriot

data.description: Should the wearer of this cape perish at the hands of Freedom's enemies, it is customary to pass the cape on to their bravest child during the funeral, inspiring the next generation to take up arms.
data.name: Honored Heirloom

data.description: Those who serve Liberty from the shadows often elect to stay anonymous, moving like traceless specters through the night. May they watch over us always.
data.name: Eye of the Clandestine

data.description: The horrors of Tyranny are manifold, their minions many, but they are naught before Democracy's twin swords: overwhelming firepower, and those trained elite who unquestioningly wield it.
data.name: Camo Cloak

data.description: "The Helldivers are all that stand between Democracy and the Fascist hordes. Trained since birth in the art of Defensive Warfare, they meet mindless legions with the steady aim of one who has seen countless battles." —Excerpt from the journal of a Charan Democracy Officer, ca. 2082 SE
data.name: City Fighter's Resolve

data.description: Gently stonewashed by experienced hands, this luxury cape exudes the essence of state-approved attitude.
data.name: Rags of the Fashionable

data.description: Designed in homage to the triangle—the most immovable of shapes—this cape digs its heels into the eye of the observer, leaving a lasting impression.
data.name: Wedgeful Tricorn

data.description: Woven from breathable adaptive camouflage mesh designed to mimic surrounding biomes, allowing them to carry out discreet compliance checks completely unbothered by less observant hostiles.
data.name: Mimetic Mesh

data.description: This cape features integrated adaptive camouflage capabilities and a vertical ladder-grid alignment pattern, defining the absolute border of Super Earth's jurisdiction. Hostile entities crossing this line are considered to have authorized their own compulsory asset liquidation.
data.name: Boundary Banner

data.description: A cape inspired by hypothetical covert operatives—pillars of Democratic order, operating in the hostile abyss where Liberty's light cannot yet reach.
data.name: Pillar of the Abyss

data.description: This vision-disruptive pattern cloaks the silent crusaders whose untraceable deeds are a pure expression of true Freedom: freedom from accountability.
data.name: Triangulation Veil

data.description: Adorned with a fearsome armored division crest, this abbreviated cape ensures the wearer's elite status is clearly broadcast to their subordinates, without the hem becoming fatally entangled in their own vehicle's heavy tread mechanisms.
data.name: Standard of Rapid Evacuation

data.description: The sheer weight of this camouflage shroud perfectly complements a Helldiver operating as a walking tank. Astute observers will also note that the shattered woodland pattern conceals a highly classified, morale-boosting message in Morse code.
data.name: Shroud of the Juggernaut

data.description: Woven from coarse, industrial fibers designed to absorb sweat and oil, this cape features a spade emblem to honor Super Earth's groundbreakers, who ensure Liberty’s light finds its way through any planet’s crust.
data.name: Dignity of Toil

data.description: With sharp geometric angles to symbolize the rigid chain of command, this cape embodies the sanctity and moral fortitude of unblemished leadership over the mud-caked warriors they direct.
data.name: Crest of the Unsullied

data.description: Some say that a mere glimpse of this cape, fluttering majestically in the breeze, is enough to spur a squad to victory.
data.name: Tideturner

data.description: A mark of stalwart loyalty bestowed only to those who have proved themselves worthy through unquestioning dedication.
data.name: EYE OF FREEDOM

data.description: Let the Second Anniversary of the Second Galactic War be witnessed by the lidless eye of Liberty, that ever-watchful orb which provides safety through its ceaseless surveillance.
data.name: EYE OF LIBERTY

data.description: Designed by fashion legend RH Gant, the pattern seen on this cape also appears on domestic dresses and gun-warmers.
data.name: Tyranny's Bane

data.description: 0.05% of profits are donated to Superstone National Park, as part of the Ministry of Unity's "Greener Galaxy" campaign.
data.name: Agent of Oblivion

data.description: A choir of patriotic schoolchildren sings the Super Earth anthem to each cape as the final step in its production.
data.name: Unblemished Allegiance

data.description: The unimpeachable justice of this cape's design is said to blind the enemies of Freedom with its glorious light.
data.name: Light of Eternal Liberty

data.description: Contains a grain of sand from Super Earth—so its bearers carry a small piece of Liberty with them, wherever they go.
data.name: Will of the People

data.description: The yellow is the exact shade of the Ministry of Unity's 'Golden Gate', leading to the Chamber of Unanimous Decision.
data.name: Cresting Honor

data.description: The two stripes serve as a reminder of the two pillars of successful military campaigns: attack, and further attack.
data.name: Liberty's Herald

data.description: Durable, waterproof, and thermally-lined, surplus units of this cape are favored by domestic campers, to make tents.
data.name: Foesmasher

data.description: This cape's cropped length symbolizes the brevity of galactic conflicts, thanks to the efficiency of the Helldivers.
data.name: Independence Bringer

data.description: Research suggests that Helldivers wearing this cape are seen as 17% more patriotic.
